Frontend spot-checks confirm salon public page 3D dark render, demo-slot picker, and book-page BookingChatWidget on bottom-left. ui_bugs.issue: On /salon/miracurl-marathahalli the DOM link[rel=manifest] resolves to /manifest-admin.json — but per this iteration's spec the public salon page must serve /manifest.json (customer-facing 'Miracurl Book' PWA). Confirmed live: DOM shows href=/manifest-admin.json on /salon/*, and correctly /manifest.json on /book/*. Root cause: ManifestSwitcher.jsx line 14 only flips to manifest.json when pathname.startsWith('/book'). It should also treat /salon/* (and /demo-slot/*) as customer-facing so an installing prospect gets the violet 'Miracurl Book' app, not the emerald partner one.
ui_bugs.priority: MEDIUM — installable PWA name/icon wrong on public salon page; users installing from a /salon/... URL get the admin-branded app

action_items: Update /app/frontend/src/components/ManifestSwitcher.jsx line 14 — treat /salon/* (and probably /demo-slot/*) as isBooking=true so the customer-facing manifest.json + violet theme + touch-icon are served. One-line fix: const isBooking = /^\/(book|salon|demo-slot)/.test(pathname);
critical_code_review_comments: hq_documents.py::demo_invite_resend (line 690) raises HTTPException(500, ...) on Resend rate-limit — better to surface 429 with retry-after so the UI can back off. The Resend free tier is 2 req/sec and this fires as a 500 in production if the operator double-clicks.

hq_documents.py::run_demo_followups iterates async cursor + calls _send_email inside the loop — a burst of 10+ pending followups will hit the same 2-req/sec limit. Consider asyncio.sleep(0.6) between sends or a Resend batch endpoint.

hq_documents.py::demo_campaign_send silently upserts an invite with responded=False even when the previous invite was demo_requested — the previous demo_requested_at/opened_at are RESET to None (line 514). If a prospect had already booked a slot and HQ mistakenly re-invites them, the funnel counter loses that conversion. Consider preserving prior opened_at/demo_requested_at on repeat send.

hq_documents.py::public_salon_page (hq_notifications.py) — services list is sorted by price DESC and limited to 24; salons with >24 services will silently drop cheaper ones from the SEO page. Consider not limiting or splitting into 'Featured' + 'All services'.

server.py::salon_gallery_upload (~2132) — no explicit MIME/type check on file.content_type; a malicious tenant admin could push non-image files up to the storage. Add file.content_type.startswith('image/') and enforce a max byte size (e.g., 5 MB) explicitly.
server.py::_review_request_candidates (line 2284) does an N+1 read of customers per completed appointment. Pre-fetch all customer_ids in one $in query.

DemoSlot.jsx: /public/demo-slot/{iid} route is not rate-limited on GET beyond the public_rate_limit decorator (30/10min) — fine; but confirm-button POST has no client-side guard against double-submit.

success_rate.frontend: spot-checks pass; 1 PWA manifest bug on /salon/*

rca of the issue: PWA manifest bug on /salon/* — ManifestSwitcher.jsx:14 uses `const isBooking = pathname.startsWith('/book')`. The /salon/{slug} public route is not caught, so the switcher defaults to /manifest-admin.json (Miracurl Partner). This means a prospect browsing your public salon page and tapping 'Add to Home Screen' installs the emerald staff PWA instead of the violet customer 'Miracurl Book' PWA. Fix: broaden the regex — `const isBooking = /^\/(book|salon|demo-slot)/.test(pathname);` (and apply same broadening for the theme/touch-icon).
